title: Change and Communications Lead
description:
As a Change And Communications Lead in Birmingham, you will shape clear communications that help teams understand and adopt change across a Business Services organisation. This role will require 1-2 days a week on-site at their Birmingham office.

Client Details

An international FTSE listed business services organisation in Birmingham.

Description

The key responsibilities for the Change and Communications Lead role will include:
- Develop clear change communication plans that explain priorities, timelines and expected outcomes.
- Create engaging written content for internal channels, helping colleagues understand business changes.
- Work with Marketing & Agency colleagues to ensure communications are consistent across relevant materials.
- Turn complex change updates into clear, accessible messages for different employee groups.
- Coordinate communication activity around change programmes, keeping key information timely and accurate.
- Gather feedback on communications and use it to improve future messages and materials.
- Maintain communication schedules and supporting content so stakeholders have clear information when needed.
- Help embed change by providing practical updates that support understanding across the business.

Profile

A successful 'Change And Communications Lead' should have:
- Experience creating clear internal communications for change activity.
- Ability to plan and manage communication activity across several audiences.
- Strong writing skills, with the ability to make complex information easy to understand.
- Experience working with marketing or communications teams to produce consistent content.
- Confidence coordinating communication plans, deadlines and supporting materials.
- Ability to use feedback to improve communication content and delivery.

Job Offer

On offer for the Change and Communications Lead role:
- Permanent Change And Communications Lead position in Birmingham.
- Hybrid working - 1-2 days per week in office.
- Salary of £45,000 to £50,000 dependent on the level of experience.

Paid Media Executive

We are working with an established and rapidly growing fashion retailer looking to strengthen its digital marketing team with the addition of multiple Paid Media Executives.
This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team, working across substantial advertising budgets and a broad range of paid media channels. You'll play an important role in driving online growth, improving campaign performance and maximising customer acquisition.

The Role

Working closely with the Paid Media Manager, you'll take responsibility for supporting and optimising paid media activity across multiple channels, including paid search, paid social, display and affiliate marketing.
You'll be involved in the full campaign lifecycle, from planning and implementation through to optimisation, testing and performance analysis.
With significant investment in paid media, this is an opportunity to gain exposure to large-scale campaigns and develop your expertise within a fast-paced ecommerce environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and optimise paid media campaigns across Google Ads, Meta and other digital advertising platforms.
- Support activity across paid search, paid social, display and affiliate marketing.
- Monitor campaign performance against key commercial objectives and KPIs.
- Manage campaign budgets, targeting, bidding strategies and audience segmentation.
- Plan and execute A/B testing across creative, audiences and campaign strategies.
- Work with internal teams to improve product feeds and audience targeting.
- Analyse campaign performance, identifying opportunities to improve ROI and drive revenue.
- Work closely with external agencies and platform partners.
- Keep up to date with emerging paid media trends and platform developments.

About You
- At least 2 years' experience working within paid media, either agency-side or in-house.
- Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads.
- Experience working within an ecommerce, retail or B2 C environment.
- Strong analytical skills and an understanding of campaign performance metrics.
- Commercially minded with a test-and-learn approach.
- Experience managing or supporting sizeable advertising budgets.
- Exposure to display and affiliate marketing would be advantageous, although training can be provided.
- Confident communicator who enjoys working collaboratively.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of 35,000- 38,000.
- Opportunity to work across significant paid media budgets.
- Exposure to multiple digital advertising channels.
- Opportunity to develop your skills within a growing ecommerce business.
- Collaborative marketing team with opportunities for progression.

25 days' holiday plus bank holidays.
Staff discount.

The opportunity to make a visible commercial impact within an established and growing business.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
Social Media Executive

Newly created role

Leading law firm

Hybrid working - Leeds, Manchester or Birmingham

My client is a well-established UK law firm with ambitious plans for continued growth. As part of this growth, the firm is investing in its brand and communications function, bringing teams more closely together and creating opportunities for people to contribute ideas, develop their expertise and have exposure to a broad range of work.

They are now looking for a Social Media Executive to join the communications team in a newly created role, taking ownership of the firm's corporate social media activity and helping to shape how this develops.

This is an opportunity to join at a point when the firm is properly establishing its social media capability. The successful candidate will look at how the firm can get greater value from its PR, thought leadership, campaigns, events and sponsorship activity, test different formats and approaches, explore opportunities across other platforms and use performance data to inform what happens next.

There is genuine scope to bring ideas. The team is open to experimentation and wants someone who is curious about new platforms and formats, can make considered recommendations and is comfortable testing what works. The role combines that creative freedom with the judgement needed to operate within a large corporate environment where brand, reputation and audience remain important.

Key responsibilities:
- Take day-to-day ownership of the firm's corporate social media activity, initially with a strong focus on LinkedIn.
- Develop the social content calendar and manage planning, scheduling, approvals, publishing and monitoring across relevant channels.
- Identify opportunities to increase the reach and impact of PR, thought leadership, campaigns, events, sponsorships and other firm content through social.
- Explore different content formats, platforms and approaches, bringing forward ideas supported by a clear rationale and understanding of the audience.
- Establish meaningful social media reporting and analytics, using performance data to identify what is working and make recommendations for future activity.
- Work closely with colleagues across communications, content, brand, multimedia, marketing operations and other teams to plan activity and maximise content across different channels.
- Monitor social conversations, platform developments, competitor activity and relevant trends, identifying opportunities and potential reputational considerations.
- Review the tools and technology available to support social media activity and contribute recommendations as the function develops.

About you:
- You are likely to have around 3 to 4 years' relevant experience and will have already gained hands-on experience managing corporate social media channels, ideally including strong exposure to LinkedIn. You should be able to demonstrate work you have delivered and explain the results or impact achieved.
- You will combine strong content judgement with an analytical approach. This means understanding social media metrics and reporting, interpreting what performance data is telling you and using that insight to make practical recommendations around content, formats, timing and channels.
- Creativity and curiosity are equally important. The team wants someone who will contribute ideas rather than wait to be told what to post, but who can balance that creativity with an understanding of brand, reputation and the requirements of a corporate audience.
- Legal or professional services experience is not essential. Experience gained within a corporate or B2 B environment would be useful, particularly where you have managed social activity across multiple stakeholders and built relationships internally to make things happen.

The opportunity:

This is a genuine development opportunity for someone who has built a strong grounding in social media and is ready for greater ownership. Rather than joining an established social function with fixed processes already in place, you will have the opportunity to help shape how the firm approaches social media, establish reporting and analytics, recommend tools and platforms and test new ways of maximising content. You will have access to wider creative and multimedia expertise and exposure to activity beyond traditional corporate content, including campaigns, events and sponsorships.

The wider business is growing, and there is potential for the remit to broaden as the firm's geographical footprint develops. The leadership approach is supportive of developing talent, giving people access to interesting work and creating room to experiment while providing appropriate guidance.

The role can be based in Birmingham, Manchester or Leeds, with occasional travel to London. The firm offers flexible hybrid working, although this opportunity will suit someone who values regular office-based collaboration and is comfortable spending around 3 days a week working with colleagues in person.

Equal Opportunities:

As a responsible business, it is important that we represent the diversity of our people, our clients and our communities. We believe that the firms that thrive are those with the most diverse team; that's why we work so hard to source the best talent from the broadest pool possible. As an equal opportunities employer we strive to accommodate anyone who may have specific needs. If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the selection process, please talk to a member of the recruitment team so that any required adjustments can be made in advance.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
SF Partners are supporting a scaling city centre based business in recruiting a Social Media Manager to join their evolving team on an interim basis. This is a really exciting opportunity to join this organisation on their trajectory of growth, and to be the face of their marketing outreach.

Temporary vacancy
Salary: £35,000-£40,000
Working pattern: full time Monday to Friday with regular travel to locations across the UK for content shoots

What you'll do
- Own and evolve the social strategy. Take our existing playbook across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok, stress-test what's working, and set the plan for the next phase of growth. Keep LinkedIn and emerging platforms in view where they fit the audience.
- Lead the Founding Circle. Launch and grow our community across its four roles: Ambassadors, Influencers, Partner Voices and UGC Creators. Recruit and onboard members, brief them clearly, manage the relationships day to day, and make sure their content is on-brand and compliant.
- Create content that performs. Plan, script, film and edit short-form video and social content end to end, from quick-turnaround trend content to planned series and campaigns. Make auctions simple to understand, in plain English with no jargon or hype.
- Be a face of the brand. Appear on camera with confidence, alongside the creators and colleagues you bring in front of the lens.
- Build an engaged community. Respond to comments and messages, spark conversation, and turn followers into buyers, sellers and advocates.
- Listen and spot what's next. Track trends, platform changes, competitor activity and audience conversations, and turn them into ideas we can act on while they're still live.
- Measure and optimise. Own social reporting each month. Go beyond reach and followers to show how social drives engagement, registrations and leads, and use the data to decide what to do more and less of.
- Work across the business. Social is your corner to own, but you'll back everyone else's too. Work with colleagues in the Growth Marketing team, and the Auction Sales Team and Customer Success Team to deliver joined-up campaigns, especially around new stock, auction events and new product launches.

Where the role is heading

This role is designed to grow with the business. As social and the Founding Circle scale, we expect you to:
- Build a social team. Help shape the structure, hire the right people and lead them day to day.
- Lead the community. Grow the Founding Circle from a launch programme into a lasting community that members are proud to be part of.
- Set the standard. Create the processes, briefs, guidelines and ways of working that let social scale without losing quality or brand consistency.

We're looking for someone who wants to be hands-on now and has the ambition and potential to lead later.

- Sector horizon scanning: Carry out regular horizon scanning of legislative, regulatory, policy, and funding developments in key sectors. Report the emerging risks and opportunities to inform business planning, strategy and risk management.
- Thought leadership & content writing: Respond quickly to key news, policy and funding developments by drafting timely thought leadership content, including opinion pieces, blogs, articles and LinkedIn posts. Work closely with the CEO and senior leadership team to shape their views into content, turning policy and sector news into accessible content for a range of audiences.
- Design & Branding: Oversee all Auriga brand touchpoints across digital and print, making sure they are consistent and high quality. Create design assets and materials including promotional collateral, annual and impact reports, and print materials. Work across a range of brands, including partner contracts and our parent charity, to deliver materials that meet each brand's guidelines.
- Bids & Tenders: Support the production of professionally designed submissions, presentations and supporting collateral for bids, tenders and client pitches.
- Website Management: Manage Auriga's website and selected partner websites, including content updates, SEO, accessibility and analytics, making sure each site stays current, functional and user-friendly.
- Event Management: Coordinate Auriga's attendance at sector events, conferences and exhibitions; including scoping, booking, managing budgets and logistics, and preparing stands and materials. Manage the delivery of Auriga's events and webinar series, working with colleagues across the organisation to ensure success across agreed objectives.
- Social Media Management: Manage and deliver social media strategy, planning sector-focused campaigns that build our profile with key audiences. Create content that shares industry insights, sector developments and Auriga's impact, and support thought leadership activity. Oversee and quality-assure content produced by the marketing executive, and use analytics to report on performance and refine the approach.
- HubSpot: Use HubSpot to capture interested contacts and open up partnership conversations for the Client Partnerships team, through gated resource forms and website pop-up banners, supported by email marketing and automations
- Internal Communications: Oversee Auriga's internal communications process, working with colleagues on day-to-day channel delivery. Support colleagues with drafting and proofreading, produce and design the internal newsletter, and help deliver internal celebrations, including the annual Auriga Awards.
- Budget Management: Tracking spend against budget and planned activity. Forecast upcoming costs, flag any variances early, and make sure spending delivers value and supports agreed priorities

Key Skills and Attributes:

Essential
- Degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Substantial marketing experience across a range of functions, including developing and delivering marketing plans and strategies aligned with business goals
- Experience of line management, or of supervising and developing team members
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including producing timely long-form and thought leadership content
- Ability to understand policy and sector developments quickly and turn them into accessible content
- Strong design skills using Adobe Creative Suite (particularly InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop), with a portfolio of professional print and digital work
- Strong digital marketing skills, including website management, digital marketing, analytics and social media campaigns
- Excellent organisational and stakeholder skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, budgets and deadlines while working with senior leaders

Desirable
- Knowledge of the not-for-profit, welfare advice or financial inclusion sectors
- A background in supporting bids, tenders and proposals
- Familiarity with HubSpot or a similar CRM and email marketing platform
- Experience of event and webinar coordination
- Confidence working across multiple brand identities

The Company:

Auriga Services is a Public Benefit Entity that has been operating for 20 years and is owned by a registered charity - Evnia Charitable Trust. As a wholly owned subsidiary, Auriga is the commercial arm of Evnia. Our charity-owned status makes us as unique in the marketplace, which allows us to genuinely care about creating better and lasting impacts for vulnerable people and households in poverty.

At Auriga Services we understand the importance of supporting people through life's challenges and our responsibilities and obligations towards our customers and beneficiaries including delivering an exceptional level of service, ensuring transparency, addressing customer concerns and upholding ethical practices to create a positive and trustworthy relationship with our consumers.

title: CRM Executive
company: Jenkins Recruitment Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
CRM Executive
Salary: £40,000-£42,000 + up to 20% bonus
Location: Birmingham, Manchester or London - Choice of Offices! Hybrid working

Are you someone who enjoys making sales teams more effective? Do you have experience with CRM systems (ideally Hubspot) and an interest in how technology and AI can improve the way businesses work?

We're working with an established UK financial services business looking for a CRM Executive / Sales Support Lead to join its Business Development Team.

Reporting to the Head of Business Development, you'll help the team identify new opportunities and keep its sales pipeline moving. You'll also have the chance to improve existing processes and find better ways to use technology to support business development.

It's a hands-on role for someone who likes taking ownership and wants to see the impact of their work.

The Role

You'll work closely with the business development team to help them manage prospects and make the most of new business opportunities.

Your responsibilities will include:

Sales pipeline: Research potential investors and help the team identify and progress new business opportunities.

CRM management: Keep records up to date and make sure the team gets the most from its CRM system. HubSpot experience would be useful.

Technology and AI: Look at ways to use AI and automation to save time and improve sales processes.

Sales support: Prepare for meetings and make sure actions are followed up.

Marketing: Work with the Marketing team to ensure sales colleagues have the information and materials they need.

Reporting: Track sales activity and provide useful insights to help the team focus on the right opportunities.

About You

You'll be organised and commercially aware, with a practical approach to getting things done. You'll be comfortable working with different people and confident enough to suggest improvements when you see a better way of doing something.

Your background might be in sales operations, sales enablement or business development support. Experience in CRM management or marketing operations would also be relevant.

We're particularly interested in people who have:

Experience using a CRM system to manage prospects or support sales activity.

Good analytical skills and confidence working with data.

An interest in AI and automation, especially where these can make everyday tasks easier.

Strong communication skills and good attention to detail.

The ability to work independently and manage their own workload.

Experience in financial services would be an advantage, but it isn't essential. We're more interested in finding someone with the right skills and attitude.

Salary & Benefits:

A salary of £40,000-£42,000, depending on experience.

Up to 20% performance-related bonus.

Hybrid working with a choice of UK office locations

Work closely with the Head of Business Development

The opportunity to develop your skills in sales technology and AI.

Location

There is flexibility around office location, with options including Birmingham, Leeds and Manchester and possibly London.

Interested?

If you enjoy improving the way sales teams work and want a role where you can make a real difference, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply now to find out more.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
We are recruiting for a Marketing Assistant to join a leading organisation in Solihull on a contract basis for 6 months

Salary: up to £37,000
Working pattern: Monday to Friday from 8:30 am to 5:00 pm, hybrid working 2 days in the office per week

We're looking for a Marketing Assistant to join the growing Group Marketing function, you'll be working with some super talented and creative people who love to drive the agenda but also have fun. Check out the role information and get in touch if it sounds exciting, we're looking forward to hearing from you. This is a fixed term contract for 6 months.

What you'll be doing
- Manage product changes and communications in line with agreed SLAs
- Create engaging content for customer emails and letters
- Collaborate with external partners to effectively promote products and messaging
- Support content updates across the channel maintaining brand consistency and audience appeal
- Monitor customer feedback and ensure regulatory compliance updates are implemented
What you'll bring to the team
- Passionate about Marketing with a growth mindset and desire to challenge the status quo
- Good understanding of marketing channels
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Highly detail-oriented with excellent organisational skills
- Curious and takes pride in their work
